name: Dwaeji Meori
source:
In an isolated Joseon village, a strange disease kills pigs and infects humans. The villagers respond with a desperate ritual: pig heads for the sick, then isolation.

[From [url=https://gunyanggae.itch.io/pig-head]Itch.io[/url]]
